description: The bar chart presents a quantitative comparison of three multimodal large language models—SRPO-7B (dark blue), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue)—across four benchmark datasets: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” ranges from 35 to 80 in increments of 5, with gridlines aiding visual alignment. On the horizontal axis, the benchmarks are listed in order: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. For MathVista, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In MathVerse, SRPO-7B scores 55.8, GRPO-7B 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 46.3. For MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 36.9. On Physics, SRPO-7B leads with 60.6, followed by GRPO-7B at 53.5 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 45.4. Across all benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently outperforms the other two models, with performance gaps varying by task. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with each model’s bar color-coded and labeled in the legend in the upper right. The chart visually emphasizes SRPO-7B’s superior performance, particularly in MathVista and Physics, while all models show a similar relative ranking across benchmarks.
